description: Turn photos of paper into clean, readable documents in the browser: a document viewer and editor for plain JavaScript, Vue and React.
rules: Install @paperpic/core for plain JavaScript, @paperpic/vue for Vue 3.5 or newer, or @paperpic/react for React 19 or newer.
Import the package stylesheet once in your app, such as @paperpic/core/style.css, @paperpic/vue/style.css or @paperpic/react/style.css.
Give the container of the viewer a height. The viewer fills its container and otherwise stays at its minimum height.
Pass src as a URL from the same origin as the page, or as a File the user picks. Always pass alt to describe the image.
Read the edited image from the blob of the apply event: pic.on('apply', ...) in JavaScript, @apply in Vue, onApply in React.
Set editable: false to show a document without editing.
With @paperpic/core, create the viewer in the browser once its element exists, and call destroy() when you remove it.
With a Content Security Policy, allow worker-src 'self' and img-src blob:.
